name: Dudes and Devils
source:
Dudes and devils is a bara-themed visual novel that goes beyond the regular railroad style of visual novels. The exciting skill check and dice roll mechanic makes sure that every play-through is unique and exciting! Prevail in challengers, seduce or fight your way thorough enemies and save kings and nobles from the disastrous peril. May the dice be ever in your favor!

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/Pauperish/overview]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《Dudes and Devils》是一部男同性恋壮汉题材视觉小说，突破了通常沿着固定路线推进的视觉小说模式。刺激的技能检定与掷骰机制，让每一次游玩都独特而精彩！克服挑战，通过诱惑或战斗突破敌人的阻拦，将国王与贵族从灾难般的危机中拯救出来。愿骰运永远与你同在！

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/Pauperish/overview]Patreon[/url]]
